title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: rejection at registration for a time-barred notice
content:
## Scope

This rule of the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line fixes when a registered notice is rejected at registration with the reason claim time-barred.

## Rule

1. A notice dated after the time bar gives the reason claim time-barred.
2. The time bar falls on the same calendar day of the month, the product's claim time bar in calendar months after the cover's delivery date.
3. When that month has no such day, the time bar falls on the last day of that month.
4. A notice dated on the time bar day is in time.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical time bar of 3 calendar months)

| Delivery date | Time bar day | Notice date | Ground applies |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 July 2025 | 10 October 2025 | 10 October 2025 | No (in time) |
| 10 July 2025 | 10 October 2025 | 11 October 2025 | Yes |
| 30 November 2024 | 28 February 2025 (February 2025 has no 30th) | 28 February 2025 | No (in time) |
| 30 November 2024 | 28 February 2025 | 1 March 2025 | Yes |

## Wrong reading and correct basis

- *Wrong reading:* the time bar is a fixed count of days. *Correct basis:* it is counted in calendar months to the same day of the month, falling back to the month's last day.
